I'm researching what happens, in this Salesforce PWA Kit storefront (Zimmermann, built on @salesforce/retail-react-app), when a product line item in a shopper's cart has become discontinued or unavailable on the site. This is to answer a business question someone asked the Frontend Lead: does SFCC/PWA Kit automatically remove the item from the cart on cart load, or does something else happen (e.g. flagged as unavailable but left in cart, blocking checkout)?

Context: This repo is a "slim overrides" project — Zimmermann-specific customizations live under overrides/app/, mirroring paths in the base template at node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/. You need to look at BOTH locations to determine (a) what the unmodified/native SFCC PWA Kit behavior is, and (b) whether Zimmermann has overridden it.

Please investigate:
1. Find the cart page/component (likely overrides/app/pages/cart or node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/cart) and any cart-item/product-item component that renders each line item.
2. Find how the basket is fetched — look for a useCurrentBasket-style hook (note: overrides/app/hooks/use-current-basket.ts is a real file in this repo if it exists — check it) and look for any logic keyed on product availability/orderable flags on a basket product-item (fields like 'orderable', productId resolution failures, inventory/ATS messages, 'itemsNotAvailable', mismatch between requested and available quantity).
3. Determine whether removal of an unavailable item is something the SFCC Shopper Baskets API appears to do server-side (i.e. the GET/PATCH basket response simply no longer contains the item, or contains it with a flag/warning/message), versus something the PWA Kit frontend does client-side (e.g. filtering line items in render, showing a toast, disabling checkout button).
4. Check for any UI treatment of an unavailable/out-of-stock/discontinued cart item — search for messaging strings like 'no longer available', 'out of stock', 'discontinued', 'unavailable' in overrides/app (including translations under overrides/app/static/translations) and in node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app (translation/message files, component files).
5. Check .docs/ (especially .docs/prd/ and .docs/integration/) for any doc describing this behavior or a product availability/inventory integration.

Report back: exact file paths and line numbers for anything relevant, and a clear, literal description of what the code actually does today (distinguish native template behavior vs Zimmermann-overridden behavior), quoting the key logic snippets. If nothing is customized in overrides/ for this flow, say so explicitly — that means the native template behavior is what's currently live on this storefront. Cite file:line for every claim.

16	/**
17	 * This hook combine some commerce-react-sdk hooks to provide more derived data for Retail App baskets
18	 * @param id - basket id to get the current used basket among baskets returned, use first basket in the array if not defined
19	 * @param shouldFetchProductDetail - boolean to indicate if the baskets should fetch product details based on basket items
20	 */
21	export const useCurrentBasket = ({id = ''} = {}) => {
22	    const storeLocatorEnabled = getConfig()?.app?.storeLocatorEnabled ?? STORE_LOCATOR_IS_ENABLED
23	    const customerId = useCustomerId()
24	    const {confirmingBasket} = useSFPayments()
25	    const {data: basketsData, ...restOfQuery} = useCustomerBaskets(
26	        {parameters: {customerId}},
27	        {
28	            enabled: !!customerId && !isServer
29	        }
30	    )
31	    // Select the current basket, prioritizing confirmingBasket, then matching id, then first non-temporary basket
32	    // Filters out temporary baskets to prevent them from showing in the cart
33	    const currentBasket =
34	        confirmingBasket && !confirmingBasket.temporaryBasket
35	            ? confirmingBasket
36	            : basketsData?.baskets?.find((basket) => basket?.basketId === id) ||
37	              basketsData?.baskets?.find((basket) => !basket.temporaryBasket)
38	
39	    const memoizedDerived = useMemo(() => {
40	        // count the number of items in each shipment and rollup total
41	        let totalItems = 0
42	        const shipmentIdToTotalItems =
43	            currentBasket?.productItems?.reduce((acc, item) => {
44	                totalItems += item.quantity
45	                acc[item.shipmentId] = acc[item.shipmentId] || 0
46	                acc[item.shipmentId] += item.quantity
47	                return acc
48	            }, {}) ?? {}
49	
50	        // count the number on non-empty pickup and delivery shipments
51	        // also count the number of delivery shipments missing an address or shipping method
52	        let totalDeliveryShipments = 0
53	        let totalPickupShipments = 0
54	        const pickupStoreIds = []
55	        let isMissingShippingAddress = false
56	        let isMissingShippingMethod = false
57	        currentBasket?.shipments?.forEach((shipment) => {
58	            if (shipmentIdToTotalItems[shipment.shipmentId]) {
59	                if (storeLocatorEnabled && isPickupShipment(shipment)) {
60	                    totalPickupShipments += 1
61	                    pickupStoreIds.push(shipment.c_fromStoreId)
62	                } else {
63	                    totalDeliveryShipments += 1
64	                    if (isAddressEmpty(shipment.shippingAddress)) {
65	                        isMissingShippingAddress = true
66	                    }
67	                    if (!shipment.shippingMethod) {
68	                        isMissingShippingMethod = true
69	                    }
70	                }
71	            }
72	        })
73	        // sorting helps with query caching
74	        pickupStoreIds.sort()
75	
76	        // Calculate total shipping cost
77	        // Use currentBasket.shippingTotal to include all costs (base _ promotions + surcharges + other fees)
78	        const totalShippingCost = currentBasket?.shippingTotal || 0
79	
80	        return {
81	            totalItems,
82	            shipmentIdToTotalItems,
83	            totalDeliveryShipments,
84	            totalPickupShipments,
85	            pickupStoreIds,
86	            isMissingShippingAddress,
87	            isMissingShippingMethod,
88	            totalShippingCost
89	        }
90	    }, [
91	        currentBasket?.productItems,
92	        currentBasket?.shipments,
93	        currentBasket?.shippingItems,
94	        storeLocatorEnabled
95	    ])
96	
97	    return {
98	        ...restOfQuery,
99	        data: currentBasket,
100	        derivedData: {
101	            // Only true if a non-temporary basket exists (temporary baskets are filtered out above)
102	            hasBasket: !!currentBasket,
103	            ...memoizedDerived
104	        }
105	    }
106	}

18	 * can't be fulfilled and will prompt the users to remove them before proceeding any further
19	 *
20	 * @param productIds -  list of product ids to check for availability. This prop will be deprecated in the upcoming release.
21	 * Please use productItems prop

23	 * @param handleUnavailableProducts - callback function to handle what to do with unavailable products
24	 * @returns {JSX.Element} -  Conformation Modal Component

27	const UnavailableProductConfirmationModal = ({
28	    productIds = [],
29	    productItems = [],
30	    handleUnavailableProducts = noop
31	}) => {
32	    const unavailableProductIdsRef = useRef(null)
33	    const ids = productIds.length ? productIds : productItems.map((i) => i.productId)
34	    const uniqueInventoryIds = [
35	        ...new Set(productItems.map((i) => i.inventoryId).filter(Boolean))
36	    ].join(',')
37	
38	    useProducts(
39	        {
40	            parameters: {
41	                ids: ids?.join(','),
42	                allImages: true,
43	                ...(uniqueInventoryIds ? {inventoryIds: uniqueInventoryIds} : {})
44	            }
45	        },
46	        {
47	            enabled: ids?.length > 0,
48	            onSuccess: (result) => {
49	                const resProductIds = []
50	                const unOrderableIds = []
51	                result.data?.forEach(({id, inventory, inventories}) => {
52	                    // when a product is unavailable, the getProducts will not return its product detail.
53	                    // we compare the response ids with the ones in basket to figure which product has become unavailable
54	                    resProductIds.push(id)
55	
56	                    // when a product is orderable, but the quantity in the basket is more than the remaining stock
57	                    // we want to make sure it is removed before go to checkout page to avoid error when placing order
58	                    // we don't need to remove low stock/ out of stock from wishlist

62	                        const isWishlist = !!productItem?.type

14	
15	const OUT_OF_STOCK = 'OUT_OF_STOCK'
16	const UNFULFILLABLE = 'UNFULFILLABLE'
17	
18	const getInventoryById = (product, inventoryId) => {
19	    if (!inventoryId || !product?.inventories) {
20	        return null
21	    }
22	    return product.inventories.find((inv) => inv.id === inventoryId)
23	}
24	
25	// TODO: This needs to be refactored.
26	// If compatibility with API version < v8.1 is needed, keep pickupInStore as false
27	export const useDerivedProduct = (
28	    product,
29	    isProductPartOfSet = false,
30	    isProductPartOfBundle = false,
31	    pickupInStore = false,
32	    controlledVariationValues = null,
33	    onVariationChange = null
34	) => {
35	    const showLoading = !product
36	    const isProductABundle = product?.type?.bundle
37	    const stockLevel = product?.inventory?.stockLevel || 0
38	    const stepQuantity = product?.stepQuantity || 1
39	    const minOrderQuantity = stockLevel > 0 ? product?.minOrderQuantity || 1 : 0
40	    const initialQuantity = product?.quantity || product?.minOrderQuantity || 1
41	
42	    // used for product bundles when there are multiple products
43	    const lowestStockLevelProductName = product?.inventory?.lowestStockLevelProductName
44	    const intl = useIntl()
45	    const variant = useVariant(
46	        product,
47	        isProductPartOfSet,
48	        isProductPartOfBundle,
49	        controlledVariationValues
50	    )
51	    const isStandardProduct = product?.type?.item
52	    const variationParams = useVariationParams(
53	        product,
54	        isProductPartOfSet,
55	        isProductPartOfBundle,
56	        controlledVariationValues
57	    )
58	    const variationAttributes = useVariationAttributes(
59	        product,
60	        isProductPartOfSet,
61	        isProductPartOfBundle,
62	        controlledVariationValues,
63	        onVariationChange
64	    )
65	    const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(initialQuantity)
66	    const {selectedStore} = useSelectedStore()
67	
68	    // A product is considered out of stock if the stock level is 0 or if we have all our
69	    // variation attributes selected, but don't have a variant. We do this because the API
70	    // will sometimes return all the variants even if they are out of stock, but for other
71	    // products it won't.
72	    const isOutOfStock =
73	        !stockLevel ||
74	        (!isProductABundle &&
75	            !variant &&
76	            !isStandardProduct &&
77	            Object.keys(variationParams).length === variationAttributes.length) ||
78	        (!isProductABundle && variant && !variant.orderable)
79	    const unfulfillable = stockLevel < quantity
80	
81	    // Product details for selected store
82	    const selectedStoreInventory = getInventoryById(product, selectedStore?.inventoryId)
83	    const selectedStoreStockLevel = selectedStoreInventory?.stockLevel || 0
84	    const selectedStoreLowestStockLevelProductName =
85	        selectedStoreInventory?.lowestStockLevelProductName
86	    // selectedStoreStockLevel and selectedStoreInventory are already variant specific,
87	    // so we don't need to check for variation attributes
88	    const isSelectedStoreOutOfStock = !selectedStoreStockLevel || !selectedStoreInventory?.orderable
89	    const selectedStoreUnfulfillable = selectedStoreStockLevel < quantity
90	
91	    // Use appropriate inventory based on pickup/delivery selection
92	    const currentStockLevel = pickupInStore ? selectedStoreStockLevel : stockLevel
93	    const currentLowestStockLevelProductName = pickupInStore
94	        ? selectedStoreLowestStockLevelProductName
95	        : lowestStockLevelProductName
96	    const currentIsOutOfStock = pickupInStore ? isSelectedStoreOutOfStock : isOutOfStock
97	    const currentUnfulfillable = pickupInStore ? selectedStoreUnfulfillable : unfulfillable
98	
99	    const inventoryMessages = {
100	        [OUT_OF_STOCK]: intl.formatMessage({
101	            defaultMessage: 'Out of stock',
102	            id: 'use_product.message.out_of_stock'
103	        }),
104	        [UNFULFILLABLE]: currentLowestStockLevelProductName
105	            ? intl.formatMessage(
106	                  {
107	                      defaultMessage: 'Only {stockLevel} left for {productName}!',
108	                      id: 'use_product.message.inventory_remaining_for_product'
109	                  },
110	                  {stockLevel: currentStockLevel, productName: currentLowestStockLevelProductName}
111	              )
112	            : intl.formatMessage(
113	                  {
114	                      defaultMessage: 'Only {stockLevel} left!',
115	                      id: 'use_product.message.inventory_remaining'
116	                  },
117	                  {stockLevel: currentStockLevel}
118	              )
119	    }
120	
121	    // showInventoryMessage controls if add to cart button is disabled
122	    const showInventoryMessage =
123	        (variant || isProductABundle || isStandardProduct) &&
124	        (currentIsOutOfStock || currentUnfulfillable)
125	    const inventoryMessage =
126	        (currentIsOutOfStock && inventoryMessages[OUT_OF_STOCK]) ||
127	        (currentUnfulfillable && inventoryMessages[UNFULFILLABLE])
128	
129	    // If the `initialQuantity` changes, update the state. This typically happens
130	    // when either the master product changes, or the inventory of the product changes
131	    // from out-of-stock to in-stock or vice versa.
132	    useEffect(() => {
133	        setQuantity(initialQuantity)
134	    }, [initialQuantity])
135	
136	    // Lump the out of stock/unfulfillable checks together for easier consumption
137	    return {
138	        showLoading,
139	        showInventoryMessage,
140	        inventoryMessage,
141	        variationAttributes,
142	        quantity,
143	        minOrderQuantity,
144	        stepQuantity,
145	        variationParams,
146	        setQuantity,
147	        variant,
148	        stockLevel,
149	        isOutOfStock,
150	        unfulfillable,
151	        isSelectedStoreOutOfStock: isSelectedStoreOutOfStock || selectedStoreUnfulfillable,
152	        selectedStore
153	    }
